definition: A candidate the composer placed whose placement no hard fact of its house type refused. It is the standing a set is filled on. It is not yet drawable: that also asks whether every fact that could be judged holds.
more: A candidate nobody placed is not counted here, and neither is one whose placement could not be evaluated: neither has been asked the type's facts, so neither is refused or not refused. The count is always shown beside the count of candidates drawable where judged, never alone.
basis: Our wording of the first of the two counts a composed set is read by. build/compose.py, set_drawability: how many are NOT REFUSED, where the placed loop "returned a placement and the type's facts did not refuse it -- `placement_standing == 'placed'`," which is the pool-fill's own test; and how many of those "finds every judged fact held and no room past its band), with each fact nobody could judge" named.
